files.name: PayProcessor issuer API integration guide v4.docx
lines: # PayProcessor issuer API integration guide, version 4
Published by PayProcessor for card issuers, July 2026. Saved here by Sheldon.
- PayProcessor sends each card authorization to the issuer endpoint over mutual TLS, with a pp_reference that identifies the request
- The issuer must answer within 2,000 ms. Without an answer, PayProcessor declines the request to the merchant with code 91 (issuer unavailable)
- Stand-in approval is off by default. An issuer that turns it on lets PayProcessor approve up to a stand-in limit and send an advice message afterwards
- An answer that arrives after 2,000 ms is logged and ignored. The issuer must release any hold it placed for that request
- A daily settlement file at 06:00 SGT lists each cleared transaction by pp_reference
| 91 | Issuer unavailable or no answer within 2,000 ms |
